lines: Nova S, yedi gün süren pille geliyor.
Kalp ritmi, uyku ve oksijen tek ekranda.
Üç renk: gece, kum ve okyanus.

acts.why: one launch in one voice: the product scans in, whip moves, huge spoken phrases

ideas: The watch lights up full frame; the claim lands in huge type
Seven slams in: days of battery
The health screen with three pins: heart rhythm, sleep, oxygen
The case weight stacked in huge type: 32 over the word gram, the number in the accent colour
The three colours pass through the gate one by one
The name, letter by letter; pre-orders today
